title: The Lord's Day
definition: The Lord's Day is the first day of the week, associated with Christ's resurrection and the gathered worship of His people.
summary: The Church gathers in light of the risen Lord and His finished work.
christFocus: Jesus Christ rose from the dead and is worshiped by His people as the living Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Lord's Day teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church gathers in light of the risen lord and his finished work.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. The Lord's Day calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let the lord's day move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
